name: Lad 2024
author: YAMAMOTO Takashi
description: A puzzle game: move your characters, push objects and switch between players to solve each stage; the first 8 are tutorials. Arrows to move, X to switch player.

descriptions.en: A puzzle game: move your characters, push objects and switch between players to solve each stage; the first 8 are tutorials. Arrows to move, X to switch player.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle game: muovi i personaggi, spingi gli oggetti e alternali per risolvere ogni livello; i primi 8 fanno da tutorial. Frecce per muoverti, X cambia personaggio.
